text:
sam: quick sanity check — gomodel-2 onboarding is failing the config-lint CI. saw errors about missing pad_token_id + tokenizer vocab path mismatch. anyone on this?
anya: yup saw the CI. excerpt: `config-lint: ERROR gomodel-2/config.json: missing field 'pad_token_id'
tokenizer.vocab_path -> file not found (s3://redwood-models/gomodel-2/vocab.json)`
mike: i uploaded shards yesterday but the path ended up under /releases/gomodel-2/v1/weights/ not /gomodel-2/weights/. i'll fix the weight_uri.
priya: heads up — tokenizer has special tokens at idx 0/1; our serving runtime expects pad_token_id != null for gpt/opt families or we fallback to eos which causes off-by-one.
sam: which config key controls it — `pad_token_id` or something else?
anya: `pad_token_id` in root of config.json. also check `tokenizer.type` (sentencepiece vs huggingface). current config has `tokenizer.type: hf` but the assets are a sentencepiece model.
mike: opening a quick PR to update weight_uri + config. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/1234 (WIP) — will add pad_token_id and update tokenizer.files[]
priya: can we add a schema rule: require pad_token_id when model_family in ["gpt","opt","mistral"] and require either tokenizer.vocab_path or tokenizer.files[]? we keep seeing both errors.
sam: good idea. also i'd prefer the CI to warn instead of hard-failing for one week for onboarding flows; we don't want to block PLG uploads.
anya: created issue #987 to toggle config-lint -> warn for onboarding bucket. cc @deploy-bot for deploy cadence.
config-lint-bot: CI output:
```
config-lint gomodel-2/config.json
ERROR: missing pad_token_id
ERROR: tokenizer.vocab_path not reachable (s3://redwood-models/gomodel-2/vocab.json) -> 404
ERROR: weight_uri (s3://redwood-models/gomodel-2/weights/) -> 404
```
mike: i'll push a manifest update in ~10m to move weights to expected path and add pad_token_id; will ping here.
priya: after mike pushes, i'll run local validator: `./tools/config-validate --schema=prod --file=gomodel-2/config.json` and add a unit test in eng-ml/tests to catch regressions.
sam: action items: 1) mike — update weight_uri + manifest; 2) anya — fix tokenizer path/type + add pad_token_id; 3) priya — add schema rules + unit test; 4) sam — set CI to warn for onboarding for 1 week.
anya: ack :thumbsup:
mike: pushed change (2187654321) — ping for CI.
deploy-bot: PR 1234 merged by mike. config-validate: passed with warnings (pad_token_id added, tokenizer.files present, weight_uri reachable)
sam: thanks team. i'll also add a short checklist item to the model onboarding doc: `verify pad_token_id` and `validate weight_uri reachable` and `tokenizer.type matches assets`.
priya: added test `test_gomodel2_config_schema` at eng-ml/tests/test_config_schema.py.
sam: closing loop — if anything else pops up reply here, otherwise i'll track the warn->fail rollback next Friday. :raised_hands:
